_comment: Approved third-party plugins. A change needs a pull request citing docs/plugins/third-party.md and a rerun of the visibility matrix. Versions must equal composer.lock. Forbidden kinds (SEO, public login, payment, AI drafting, page builders) fail even if listed.

plugins.reason: Background jobs, used as a library inside whoiswho-core (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Background jobs, Chosen). Touches no personal data of its own.

Staff two-factor sign-in, enforced for every user with recovery codes (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Staff two-factor; D-050, Q76; owner approved on issue #2). Stores the user's second-factor secrets in user meta; loaded by whoiswho-core so it cannot be deactivated.

Required. Sends the site's email through the owner's mail account (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Mail delivery; REQ-075). Installed by the Administrator from wordpress.org on the Required plugins screen (whoiswho-core), not through the lockfile; the version is the one tested. Holds the SMTP account details in its own option and, unless switched off, keeps a log of sent mail in its own table.

Required. The comment form on stories (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Story comments; REQ-258, D-059). Installed by the Administrator from wordpress.org on the Required plugins screen, not through the lockfile; the version is the one tested. whoiswho-core forces its settings to the comment rules (Content/Comments/WpdiscuzSettings) and exports and erases its subscription and follow tables (CommentPrivacy).

Per-user capability and role screen (docs/plugins/third-party.md: Per-user capability screen, Decided Q86; owner approved on issue #2). Limited to wiw_manage_capabilities (Administrator only), loaded by whoiswho-core; the guard still refuses fixed capabilities. Touches no visitor data.

Page cache for anonymous public pages only (docs/plugins/third-party.md; D-060, Q82; owner approved on issue #2; WP Super Cache chosen by default, swappable through the PurgeClient interface). Loaded by whoiswho-core only when WP_CACHE is on, its settings screen is hidden, and PageCachePolicy marks every non-public request DONOTCACHEPAGE. Stores rendered public HTML only.
